### CVE-2008-0192
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2008-01-10 | Updated: 2024-08-07 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 30978: WordPress Core 2.2.3 - '/wp-admin/page-new.php?popuptitle' Cross-Site Scripting (webapps/php, 2008-01-03, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 30977: WordPress Core 2.2.3 - '/wp-admin/post.php?popuptitle' Cross-Site Scripting (webapps/php, 2008-01-03, verified=1)

Multiple cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerabilities in WordPress 2.0.9 and earlier allow remote attackers to inject arbitrary web script or HTML via the popuptitle parameter to (1) wp-admin/post.php or (2) wp-admin/page-new.php.
